[[File:Jared.png|thumb|250px|Jared]] '''Jared''' (Japanese: '''タクミ''' ''Takumi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the [[Pokémon Chronicles]] episode ''[[HS15|Putting the Air Back in Aerodactyl!]]''. Jared is a research assistant in the [[Sayda Lab]], a part of the research team headed by [[Dora]]. He's put in charge of escorting {{Tracey}} and {{an|Professor Oak}} to [[Sayda Island]] and helps in the search for the missing {{p|Aerodactyl}}. He was very excited to show Tracey and Professor Oak how well Gary had been doing. Jared's character was not developed very much, as he had very little on-screen time and not many speaking parts, but he is a valued assistant to the research team at Sayda Laboratory. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{rock color}}|bordercolor={{rock color light}} |ja=小西克幸 ''[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]'' |en=[[Wayne Grayson]] |es_eu=Fernando Cabrera |it=Davide Garbolino}}
